events.title: Yen Slides Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The U.S. dollar weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday.

events.title: Bay Street Likely To Open On Positive Note
events.description:
Canadian stocks may open higher on Monday as a sharp drop in oil prices is expected to ease concerns about inflation. 

Oil prices fell sharply today amid hopes for a progress in diplomatic talks to ease tensions between Iran and the U.S.

events.title: Wall Street Likely To Open On Firm Note
events.description: Notably higher futures and easing concerns about inflation following a sharp fall in oil prices point to a positive start for U.S. stocks Monday morning.

events.title: FTSE 100 Climbs Higher Amid Oil Decline, U.K. Housing Recovery
events.description: The FTSE 100 advanced 95.80 points to 10,754.93 on Monday as Brent crude dropped 3.5% to $100.20 amid diplomatic progress expectations at the UN. U.K. house prices rose 0.7% month-on-month in September, the first increase in four months.

events.title: CAC 40 Climbs As Oil Prices Fall On Middle East Diplomatic Hopes
events.description: France's CAC 40 benchmark climbed 0.98% as oil prices fell sharply on hopes for Middle East diplomatic progress. Brent crude dropped to $101.19, losing over 2.5%. Geopolitical tensions eased following discussions between U.S. and Gulf leaders.

events.title: Indian Shares Rise As Oil Prices And Bond Yields Dip On US-Iran Diplomacy Hopes
events.description: Indian shares closed Monday's session higher as oil prices extended slide to their lowest levels in more than a week and global bond yields dipped amid hopes that diplomatic efforts could help ease tensions in West Asia.

events.title: DAX Rises More Than 1% On Oil Decline And German Reform Push
events.description: German equities surged Monday with the DAX gaining 280.35 points to 25,576.79 amid declining oil prices and Chancellor Friedrich Merz's reform commitment. Brent crude dropped over 2.5% on Middle East diplomatic hopes.

events.title: Gold Edges Lower On Rate Hike Concerns
events.description: Gold prices were moving lower on Monday due to expectations for additional Federal Reserve rate hikes.

events.title: Oil Extends Slide As US-Iran Diplomacy Gathers Pace
events.description: Oil prices extended slide to their lowest levels in more than a week on Monday amid hopes that diplomatic efforts could help ease tensions in West Asia.

events.title: European Shares Climb As Inflation Worries Ease
events.description: European stocks advanced on Monday as falling oil prices eased inflation concerns and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz vowed to press ahead with reforms after suffering a bruising electoral setback in two state elections.

events.title: Asian Shares Rise As US-Iran Diplomacy Gains Momentum
events.description: Asian stocks rose broadly on Monday as oil extended declines on hopes of a diplomatic path to de-escalate the U.S.-Iran war. Regional volumes were thin as Japanese markets remained closed for a three-day holiday weekend ending September 23.

events.title: European Shares Seen Higher As Oil Extends Slide On Diplomacy Hopes
events.description: European stocks are seen opening higher on Monday as oil prices extended slide to their lowest levels in more than a week on hopes that diplomatic efforts could help ease tensions in West Asia.
